summary: Greenlight Capital Re, Ltd. filed an 8-K disclosing an Ordinary Share Repurchase Agreement with the David M. Einhorn 2021-07 Family Trust, an affiliate of Chairman David Einhorn. The company will repurchase a number of shares equal to 33% of its open-market buybacks under its existing authorization during August 7–October 26, 2026, priced at the weighted average repurchase price. The transaction is structured to keep Mr. Einhorn's ownership percentage approximately constant, avoiding adverse tax consequences. Closing is expected on or about October 30, 2026, with termination rights if no buybacks occur. Watch for actual buyback volume and pricing mechanics.
